Convert datasets between supported table file formats.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Category | [I/O](../categories/io.md) |
| Status | Runs |
| Search words | csv, tsv, parquet, feather, arrow, ipc, convert, conversion, format, cache, file |
| Settings | In its own window (double-click the node) |

## Inputs

| Pin | Type | Required | Connections | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **Input** | Dataset | No | 1 | Optional input dataset artifact; input_path is used when disconnected |

## Outputs

| Pin | Type | Required | Connections | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **Output** | Dataset | Yes | 1 | Converted dataset artifact |

## Settings

| Setting | Key | Type | Default | Allowed values | Read by | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| input_path | `input_path` | File | (empty) | `*.csv;*.tsv;*.jsonl;*.json;*.ndjson;*.txt;*.text;*.arff;*.npy;*.hdf5;*.h5;*.hdf;*.xlsx;*.parquet;*.pq;*.feather;*.fea;*.ipc;*.arrow` | The run | Input data file. |
| input_format | `input_format` | Choice | `auto` | `auto`, `csv`, `tsv`, `jsonl`, `json`, `ndjson`, `txt`, `text`, `arff`, `npy`, `hdf5`, `h5`, `hdf`, `xlsx`, `excel`, `parquet`, `pq`, `feather`, `fea`, `ipc`, `arrow`, `arrowipc` | The run | Input format. |
| output_path | `output_path` | File | (empty) | `*.csv;*.tsv;*.jsonl;*.json;*.ndjson;*.txt;*.text;*.arff;*.npy;*.hdf5;*.h5;*.hdf;*.parquet;*.pq;*.feather;*.fea;*.ipc;*.arrow` | The run | Output data file. |
| output_format | `output_format` | Choice | `auto` | `auto`, `csv`, `tsv`, `jsonl`, `json`, `ndjson`, `txt`, `text`, `arff`, `npy`, `hdf5`, `h5`, `hdf`, `parquet`, `pq`, `feather`, `fea`, `ipc`, `arrow`, `arrowipc` | The run | Output format. |
| XLSX worksheet (blank selects first) | `excel_sheet` | Text | (empty) |   | The run | XLSX reads one worksheet: blank sheet name selects the first sheet. Values only; formulas, merged cells, mixed column types and binary attachments (including images) reject. Dates remain numeric Excel serials. UTF-8 XML only; 64 MiB compressed/expanded archive, 16 MiB per part, 512 parts, one million cells, 1 MiB headers and 64 MiB strings. Excel export, .xls and media tensors are not supported. |
| XLSX start column | `excel_start_column` | Text | `A` |   | The run | XLSX only: first column to read (A to XFD, inclusive). Use with Skip rows to select an offset table. Earlier columns are explicitly excluded; no header detection is performed. |
| delimiter | `delimiter` | Choice | `auto` | `auto`, `,`, `\t`, `;`, `\|` | The run | CSV delimiter. |
| decimal_point | `decimal_point` | Choice | `.` | `.`, `,` | The run | Input decimal separator. |
| header | `header` | On / off | `true` |   | The run | Treat the first selected CSV/TSV/XLSX row as column names. |
| allow_newlines_in_values | `allow_newlines_in_values` | On / off | `true` |   | The run | Allow quoted multiline CSV values. |
| skip_rows | `skip_rows` | Integer | `0` | `>=0` | The run | Rows skipped before parsing. |
| compression | `compression` | Choice | `snappy` | `none`, `snappy`, `gzip`, `zstd`, `brotli` | The run | Parquet compression. |
| row_group_size | `row_group_size` | Integer | `1048576` | `>0` | The run | Parquet rows per row group. |
| overwrite | `overwrite` | On / off | `false` |   | The run | Allow replacing an existing output file. |
| create_parent_dirs | `create_parent_dirs` | On / off | `true` |   | The run | Create missing output folders. |
| write_manifest | `write_manifest` | On / off | `true` |   | The run | Write the conversion manifest. |
| configured | `configured` | On / off | `false` |   | The editor only | Dialog configured. |
| status | `status` | Text | `Not run` |   | The editor only | Last conversion status. |
| rows_written | `rows_written` | Integer | `0` |   | The editor only | Rows written by the last conversion. |

**Read by** says whether a run uses the setting (**The run**) or only the editor, a dialog or a view (**The editor only**).

## Where it runs
